content.notes: Code review of module.py (candidate e9aa2342...) against the user contract. solve() raises ValueError unless data is an object containing base and patch, and unless base and patch are both objects. _merge recursively merges when both values are objects, replaces lists without concatenation, inserts absent keys as clones, and removes keys on null via pop with a default, so absent-key null is a no-op. _json_type separates boolean from number and raises ValueError on any type mismatch, including null versus non-null. Key order follows from cloning base in order and appending patch-only keys in patch order. Inputs are not mutated: base is deep-cloned before merging, and patch values are cloned on insertion.
